name: Mount Rainier National Park
summary: The glaciated 14,411-ft giant that looms over Seattle — wildflower meadows at Paradise and high alpine views at Sunrise.

lodging.name: Paradise Inn (in-park) or an Ashford lodge
lodging.blurb: The historic inn puts you at the trailheads.

item.title: Paradise & the Skyline Trail

location.name: Paradise, Mount Rainier
location.address: Paradise Rd, Mount Rainier National Park, WA

item.blurb: The famous subalpine meadows in bloom and the Skyline Trail up toward the glaciers.

days.label: Day 492 — Sunrise & Old Growth
days.summary: The high side and ancient trees.

item.title: Sunrise & the Grove of the Patriarchs

location.name: Sunrise, Mount Rainier
location.address: Sunrise Rd, Mount Rainier National Park, WA

item.blurb: Drive to Sunrise, the highest point you can reach by car, then walk the old-growth Grove of the Patriarchs.

rest.label: The meadows, at an amble
rest.note: You have hiked at altitude two days running and Olympic is next. Take Paradise slowly and watch the mountain go pink — it is the last thing to lose the light for a hundred miles in any direction.
